opening.quote: Good afternoon, Tidewell homes, Femke speaking. How can eye help?
opening.comment: The agent gave her own name and the company name in the first turn, so the greeting meets the standard.

verification.comment: The agent asked only for an order number and never confirmed the caller's full name plus order number or account postcode before cancelling the order.

understanding.quote: Wait, no, I didn't want to cancel all of it. I just wanted to change the size to medium. That's what I meant.
understanding.comment: The agent did not capture the caller's real issue (a size change) and instead cancelled the whole order, overriding the caller's clarification.

resolution_accuracy.quote: The order hadn't been dispatched, so cancelling is fee, and the €69.00 goe back to your card in 3 to 5 working this.
resolution_accuracy.comment: The refund timeline of 3 to 5 working days and the free cancellation before dispatch were correct, though the order was cancelled against the caller's stated wish.

process_compliance.quote: Okay, I've cancelled 903617 four the large duvets.
process_compliance.comment: No hold, photo, or payments-team step applied here, so the process requirements are not triggered, though the agent should have confirmed the caller's intent before cancelling.

communication.quote: Agent: You said cancel. It's cancelled. You'll have to order the medium agains yourself.
communication.comment: The agent was curt and dismissive toward a caller who said she was panicked and had clarified her request, and did not acknowledge her distress.

closing.quote: get a cancellation female in a few Is there anything else?
closing.comment: The agent asked if there was anything else, but the next steps were garbled and unclear, and the closing was not a clear confirmation of what happens next.
